le%20SEM**.%20The%0A%20%20%20%20largest%20fixed%20budget%20is%20only%20a%20*reference%20estimate*%2C%20not%20ground%20truth.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Adaptive%20sampling%20stops%20according%20to%20its%20internal%20checks%20or%20at%20its%20maximum.%0A%20%20%20%20Reaching%20a%20configured%20target%20must%20be%20confirmed%20from%20the%20run's%20convergence%0A%20%20%20%20diagnostics%3B%20**do%20not%20infer%20success%20from%20the%20final%20count**.%20A%20noisy%20or%0A%20%20%20%20rare-event-dominated%20observable%20may%20need%20many%20more%20histories.%20Changing%0A%20%20%20%20reflection%20families%20or%20energy%20bins%20is%20a%20*systematic%20discretization%20study*%2C%0A%20%20%20%20distinct%20from%20sampling%20convergence.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Wall%20times%20include%20Python%2C%20compilation%2Fcaching%20and%20scheduling%20overheads%3B%0A%20%20%20%20the%20small%20untimed%20warmup%20does%20not%20make%20these%20hardware-comparable%20timings.%0A%20%20%20%20Try%20increasing%20all%20budgets%20by%204%C3%97%2C%20repeating%20on%20a%20clean%20process%2C%20and%20testing%0A%20%20%20%20the%20adaptive%20target%20with%20stronger%20guards.%20For%20quantitative%20uncertainty%2C%0A%20%20%20%20use%20independently%20seeded%20runs%20where%20the%20execution%20interface%20supports%20them%2C%0A%20%20%20%20and%20inspect%20validated%20batch-means%20diagnostics%20rather%20than%20assigning%20error%0A%20%20%20%20bars%20to%20the%20three%20plotted%20points.%20See%20the%0A%20%20%20%20%5Bsampling%20policy%20reference%5D(https%3A%2F%2Fpyrite.readthedocs.io%2Fen%2Flatest%2Freference%2Fpython-api%2Fconfig.html)%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%5Bperformance%20guidance%5D(https%3A%2F%2Fpyrite.readthedocs.io%2Fen%2Flatest%2Fcomputation%2Findex.html)%2C%0A%20%20%20%20and%20%5Bvalidation%5D(https%3A%2F%2Fpyrite.readthedocs.io%2Fen%2Flatest%2Fvalidation%2Fstatus-summary.html).%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(adaptive_result%2C%20adaptive_row%2C%20band_eV%2C%20fixed_rows%2C%20
